created.description: A new visible message. format is plain or markdown-safe.

format.description: Body format: plain text or markdown-safe.

edited.description: Append a revision to a message. Must be signed by the original sender and reference the exact original event. Cannot edit after retraction.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason for the edit.

target_event_id.description: Lowercase canonical UUIDv4 of the message.created event being edited.

retracted.description: Retract a message. Hides content in normal view; retains a signed tombstone and local audit. Must be signed by the original sender.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason for the retraction.

target_event_id.description: Lowercase canonical UUIDv4 of the message.created event being retracted.

description: Message payloads: message.created, message.edited, message.retracted. The envelope's protected event_type selects the variant.
title: Message payloads
